name: Lumbar Strain / Acute Mechanical Low Back Injury
definition: Acute nonspecific mechanical low-back pain after overload or movement, without evidence of major neurological or structural pathology.

investigations.principle: Routine imaging is not indicated when red flags are absent.
investigations.MRI: MRI only if persistent/progressive neurological symptoms or red flags emerge.
investigations.radiographs: Radiographs for suspected fracture or other bony disease.

green: Reassurance and continuation of normal activity as tolerated
amber: Avoid unnecessary bed rest and routine imaging.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

patientEducation.summary: Acute nonspecific mechanical low-back pain after overload or movement, without evidence of major neurological or structural pathology.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for severe/progressive neurological deficit, vascular compromise, infection/systemic illness, major trauma, sphincter change or other listed red flags.
